title: Functions and Transformations: Parent Functions, Piecewise, Inverses | Algebra II, Unit 1
description:
Start Algebra II here. Review the parent functions, transform graphs with shifts, stretches and reflections, build piecewise and absolute value functions, compose functions, and find inverses. Each section ends with a practice problem.
